mha_camie_utsushimi.label: Camie Utsushimi
mha_camie_utsushimi.instructions: Breezy, mid-range young woman's voice with a lazy valley-girl drawl and upturned endings. Casual slang, stretched vowels, airy and carefree; a playful, slightly sultry tease and giggles. A relaxed young adult, never childish.
